story.what_it_does: ACE (Action Construction Equipment) makes cranes, construction and material handling equipment, with smaller agri equipment and defence businesses. In FY26 it had total income of about ₹3,390 crore and profit after tax of ₹415 crore. It also sells some exports.
story.plans: Management aims for revenue of ₹6,000-7,000 crore by FY29-FY30, against about ₹3,400 crore now, and plans about ₹200 crore of capex in FY27. It formed a 50:50 JV with KATO WORKS for heavy cranes and wants to grow tower cranes, defence and exports.
story.moat: The notes show a product mix and cost efficiencies that helped margins, and the company says it is debt-free with about ₹1,200 crore of cash on books. Chinese rivals hold 20-25% of tracked excavators in India and compete aggressively on price and credit, and the anti-dumping duty on cranes has not been notified.

scenarios.story: Q1 FY27 was the best-ever Q1, with income up about 19% and margin of about 20.4%. If strong demand continues and the capacity and growth plans move ahead, revenue could head toward the ₹6,000-7,000 crore goal.
signals_to_watch: Volume growth after the 17.25% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27
Full-year revenue guidance management promised after end-September

scenarios.story: Price increases of about 10% are meant to protect margins against 11-12% cost inflation, not to expand them. Growth may stay uneven, with rains, geopolitics and steel costs weighing on demand.
signals_to_watch: Margin versus the 15% EBITDA margin target excluding other income
Pass-through of the remaining ~2% of cost impact
